title: Minimal Backend Proxy
description: A small Flask server that holds the provider key on the server side, so the browser never sees it.

steps.description: The header comments name the file `minimal_proxy.py` and show the run command with a real key in the environment, and warn never to commit it. It imports `os`, `requests`, and the Flask pieces.
Create the Flask app and read the key from `os.environ`. The comment marks this as coming from the environment, not the source code, which is the whole point of the proxy.
Define the `POST /api/coach` route. The browser calls this endpoint, and the handler reads the user prompt from the request JSON.
Post to the OpenAI chat completions endpoint with the key added server-side in the `Authorization` header, sending the model and a single user message, with a 120-second timeout.
Parse the response and return the reply text as JSON. The page says the secret never leaves your server and users never see it.
